title.zh: 阿卡德滚筒印章的现代印痕

alt.en: A grey rolled impression shows standing and seated figures with vertical plant-like forms.
alt.zh: 灰色滚印上可见站立与端坐的人物，以及竖直植物状纹样。

caption.en: Modern impression of an Akkadian chlorite cylinder seal, about 2350–2150 BCE; Met 1984.383.9. The displayed image shows the impression, not the cylinder itself.
caption.zh: 阿卡德绿泥石滚筒印章的现代印痕，印章约作于前2350—2150年；大都会1984.383.9。所示为印痕，而非印章本体。

interpretation.en: The rolled scene makes the miniature imagery of seals visible. Its figures are not securely identified here as Sargon or Naram-Sin.
interpretation.zh: 展开的印痕使印章的微型图像可见；此处不将其中人物指认为萨尔贡或纳拉姆辛。

items.creator: Unrecorded maker
items.date: Seal ca. 2350–2150 BCE; modern impression, undated
items.credit: Gift of Martin and Sarah Cherkasky, 1984

alt.en: A circular silver seal face with small incised signs sits above a curved handle.
alt.zh: 圆形银印面刻有细小符号，下方可见弯曲把手。

caption.en: Hittite silver stamp seal with a handle and hieroglyphic inscription, about the fourteenth–thirteenth century BCE; Met 1983.135.7.
caption.zh: 带柄及象形铭文的赫梯银制戳印，约前十四至十三世纪；大都会1983.135.7。

interpretation.en: A small inscribed object brings writing into view beside the monumental scale of Hattusha. The collection identifies Anatolia, not a findspot at the capital.
interpretation.zh: 带铭文的小物件与哈图沙的宏伟建筑形成尺度对照。馆藏记录注明安纳托利亚，并未确认出土于都城。

alt.en: A green-patinated round medallion carries a raised male bust with swept hair.
alt.zh: 泛绿铜锈的圆饰上凸起一尊男子半身像，头发向两侧梳展。

caption.en: Copper-nickel medallion, about the first century CE, attributed to India, probably Maharashtra; Met 2003.16.1.
caption.zh: 铜镍合金圆饰，约公元一世纪，归属印度、可能马哈拉施特拉；大都会2003.16.1。

interpretation.en: The museum compares this possible cloak clasp with West Asian portrait forms circulating in luxury markets. The sitter is unnamed, not an identified Satavahana ruler.
interpretation.zh: 馆方将这件可能的披风扣与流通于奢侈品市场的西亚肖像形式相比较。像主未具名，并非已确认的百乘君主。

title.en: A Ghaznavid-period bowl names its maker
title.zh: 刻有匠人名字的伽色尼时期铜碗

alt.en: A shallow bronze bowl carries dense bands of engraved script inside and outside.
alt.zh: 浅腹铜碗的内外壁刻有密集的文字带。

caption.en: High-tin bronze bowl by Abu Nasr al-Naqqash, eleventh century, attributed to Afghanistan, probably Ghazni; Met 1971.42.
caption.zh: 阿布·纳斯尔·纳卡什制作的高锡青铜碗，十一世纪，归属阿富汗、可能伽色尼；大都会1971.42。

interpretation.en: Arabic maxims, good wishes and the maker’s name turn a metal vessel into evidence of craft and written expression during the Ghaznavid period.
interpretation.zh: 阿拉伯文格言、祝愿及匠人名字，使金属器成为伽色尼时期工艺与文字表达的证据。

title.en: Shiva or a guardian in Cham stone carving
title.zh: 占婆石雕中的湿婆或守门神

alt.en: A standing stone figure with a tall headdress and short wrap holds an object beside one shoulder.
alt.zh: 站立石像戴高冠、着短裙，一侧肩旁持物。

caption.en: Cham stone sculpture, first half of the tenth century, identified as Shiva or a temple guardian; Met 1987.478.
caption.zh: 占婆石雕，十世纪上半叶，识别为湿婆或寺庙守门神；大都会1987.478。

interpretation.en: The Met dates the carving by comparison with temple sculpture at My Son and Khoung My. The figure’s identity remains uncertain, and the record does not establish a My Son findspot.
interpretation.zh: 大都会通过与美山及姜美寺庙雕刻比较为其断代。像主身份仍有不确定性，记录也未确认其出土于美山。

items.date: ca. first half of the 10th century
